roster.note: first uncrewed Shenzhou test flight — the proof that China could fly its own crew capsule

roster.name: Shenzhou 5
roster.note: Yang Liwei becomes the first Chinese astronaut in orbit — China joins the US and USSR as the third nation to launch a human on its own rocket

roster.name: Shenzhou 9 → Tiangong-1
roster.note: first crewed docking with a Chinese station; Liu Yang becomes China's first woman in space

roster.name: Tianhe core module
roster.note: the core of the permanent station reaches orbit; continuous crewed occupation of the Chinese Space Station begins that year

roster.name: Station complete
roster.note: the Wentian and Mengtian laboratory modules join Tianhe — the T-shaped, three-module CSS is finished and permanently crewed

ISS — the station Tiangong was locked out of
